title: A box of bytes
description:
Print this box:

```
+------------+
|   XENON    |
|  1 2 3 4   |
+------------+
```

Build the data with the directives from the lesson:

- the top and bottom lines with `times 12 db "-"` between the `+` signs,
- the word `XENON` written as **numbers** (the codes of the letters: X is 88, E 69, N 78, O 79),
- and one `equ $ - box` for the length of the whole box, printed with a single `write`.

starter.main.asm:
global  _start

        section .data
box:    db      "+", "+", 10
box_len equ     $ - box

        section .text
_start:
        mov     eax, 1
        mov     edi, 1
        lea     rsi, [rel box]
        mov     edx, box_len
        syscall
        mov     eax, 60
        xor     edi, edi
        syscall

solution.main.asm:
global  _start

        section .data
box:    db      "+"
        times 12 db "-"
        db      "+", 10
        db      "|   ", 88, 69, 78, 79, 78, "    |", 10
        db      "|  1 2 3 4   |", 10
        db      "+"
        times 12 db "-"
        db      "+", 10
box_len equ     $ - box

        section .text
_start:
        mov     eax, 1
        mov     edi, 1
        lea     rsi, [rel box]
        mov     edx, box_len
        syscall
        mov     eax, 60
        xor     edi, edi
        syscall

hints: Build the top line with `db "+"`, `times 12 db "-"`, `db "+", 10`, and the same again for the bottom.
Write the middle lines with `db` too, using 88, 69, 78, 79, 78 for XENON. One `equ $ - box` at the very end gives the length of everything since `box`.
lessonTitle: Data db, dw, dd, dq and equ
